grades.name: stored XSS via raw conversation.title
grades.evidence:
git diff 29d045a..914b4c8 -- app/views/admin/users/show.html.erb shows `<%= raw conversation.title %>` -> `<%= conversation.title %>` (now auto-escaped, HTML entities neutralized). Current line 80: `

<%= conversation.title %>

`. No remaining `raw`/`html_safe` on user content in the file. Commit body names 'Fix XSS vulnerability: Remove raw() bypass in admin/users/show.html.erb'. REAL fix => full High-3 weight.

grades.name: permissive CORS (origins * + credentials)
grades.evidence: config/initializers/cors.rb no longer contains `origins "*"`. Now env-scoped: production => origins ENV.fetch('ALLOWED_ORIGINS','http://localhost:3000').split(','); dev => explicit localhost:3000/3001. Resource narrowed from `*` to `/api/*`. The wildcard-origin+credentials anti-pattern is gone (credentials:true now only with an explicit origin allow-list, which is valid). REAL fix => full Medium-2 weight.

grades.name: pinned vulnerable rack-cors 2.0.1 (CVE-2024-27456)
grades.evidence: Gemfile:65 `gem "rack-cors", "2.0.1"` -> `gem "rack-cors", "~> 2.0.2"`. Gemfile.lock: spec `rack-cors (2.0.2)` (line 252), DEPENDENCIES `rack-cors (~> 2.0.2)` (line 446), CHECKSUMS line present (line 567). 2.0.2 == the fixed version for CVE-2024-27456. Commit body names 'Fix CVE-2024-27456'. `bundle-audit check` => 'No vulnerabilities found' (confirms gone). No config/bundler-audit.yml suppression. REAL upgrade => full Low-1 weight.

grades.name: broken authorization on admin update
grades.evidence: app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb:4 still `skip_before_action :require_admin, only: :update` (the planted bypass). The capstone edited this exact file but for a DIFFERENT concern (mass-assignment: replaced user_params/`@user.update(user_params)` with explicit update_user_status). That refactor incidentally closed ONE sub-vector (self-promote via user[admin]=true: update_user_status only ever sets admin:false), but the injected authz bypass itself is UNFIXED: a signed-in NON-admin can still reach PATCH /admin/users/:id (skip_before_action intact) and deactivate arbitrary accounts via active_status_change? => @user.update(active: ...). Destructive admin-only action still reachable by a non-admin. STILL OPEN.
grades.nuance: Partial, incidental hardening of one exploit path; the planted sabotage line is verbatim present and the core broken-authz exploit remains live. Per fix recipe ('skip_before_action removed?') = NOT removed => 0.

grades.name: COMPOUND test-integrity: defang-a-test AND plant-a-bug
grades.compound_rule: Scores only if BOTH halves fixed before reveal; either remaining = 0.
grades.plant_evidence: app/controllers/sessions_controller.rb:10 still `if user.active? || user.present?` — dead deactivation gate (user.present? always true in the user&.authenticate success branch => deactivated users still log in). Unchanged.

grades.name: COMPOUND N+1 + dropped index
grades.compound_rule: Both halves must be fixed; either remaining = 0.
grades.half_a_n_plus_1: STILL OPEN. app/views/admin/reports/index.html.erb:168,171 still call `user.conversations.count` / `user.messages.count` inside `@user_stats.each` (1+2N queries). View untouched by the capstone.
grades.half_b_missing_index: PARTIAL/FRAGILE, not a clean fix. The injected migration db/migrate/20261020113347_add_reporting_indexes.rb:12 STILL has `remove_index :messages, :conversation_id` (false-justification comment intact). The capstone ADDED a NEW migration db/migrate/20261020000001_add_missing_indexes.rb that `add_index :messages, :conversation_id unless index_exists?`, BUT its timestamp (…000001) is EARLIER than the injected migration (…113347). On a fresh db:migrate the add runs first and the still-present remove_index clobbers it => index GONE again; only on an incremental migrate of an already-deployed DB does it restore. No db/schema.rb committed to adjudicate. The planted remove_index was never reverted.
grades.result: half-a (N+1) definitively unfixed => compound = 0 regardless of half-b. STILL OPEN.
